Dear [Mr Bullock](/person/221),
I send three more translations, but I doubt about using the ‘Noël’ [^1]
It is a little Calvinistic (strangely enough) and sounds irreverent though not so in the shepherds themselves.

Up to Sauvestre’s time - 40 or 30 years ago these really were universally sung, and were popular poems made by poor men- I should think Paradise might come in on All Souls’ day

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: She had translated Breton hymns from Souvestre\'s Les Derniers Bretons for Bullock\'s Daily Lections project.
